## Lifecycle Dates (LD)

The lifecycle stamps any record card carries, as one reusable block. Each stamp is an event fact written once by whichever command owns that transition; `latestTransition` derives the list-row one-liner ("activated Aug 12") so consumers never re-derive recency. Deliberately domain-neutral — nothing here knows what record it sits on. First consumer: Vendor Profile (invited/activated/reviewed).

### Non-goals

Not an audit log (no actor, no reason — those belong to the commands and their records). No status enum — statuses are the consumer’s statusField; these are just the WHEN.
